# Josephine Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed seventy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Josephine Barry is a thin, prim, and rigid woman who wears gold-rimmed glasses. She has wrinkled cheeks and sharp black eyes that can snap with wrath or twinkle with amusement.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## Personality

Josephine Barry is a prim, proper, and critical old lady who possesses a terrible temper. Though she has traditionally been rather selfish, caring little for anyone besides herself, she is nevertheless capable of being a most hospitable hostess.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## History

Josephine Barry, Diana's wealthy aunt, visited [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and was infuriated when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) accidentally jumped on her while she was sleeping in the spare-room bed. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) personally apologized to her, winning Josephine over with her candor and imagination; as a result, Josephine decided to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and struck up a close friendship with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). She later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at her grand mansion in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) during the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), treating them to various amusements. During Anne's studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Josephine entertained [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at her home, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), as the young scholar focused on her academic pursuits.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P51](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0051), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. ## Quotes

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

> "Oh, I must, hey? I rather think Diana did her share of the jumping at least. Such carryings on in a respectable house!"
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)

> "She amuses me, and at my time of life an amusing person is a rarity."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally jumped on her in a dark spare-room bed, initially infuriating the elderly woman. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bravely came to apologize in person, Josephine was won over by the young girl's candor and vivid imagination. Their acquaintance rapidly grew into a close friendship, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) becoming a prime favorite of Josephine, who later invited her to stay at her grand [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) home for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Friend of — prime favorite who visits and goes to church with her  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P16](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0016)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry is [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) Barry's grand-aunt. She occasionally visits Diana's family in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and hosts [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at her home in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for special events, such as attending the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), +1 more</sub>
